segments.name: tobacco
segments.description: Makes and sells reduced-nicotine VLN cigarettes and provides contract manufacturing for other tobacco brands.
segments.evidence: As a result of the divestiture of GVB, during the fourth quarter of 2023, the Company reorganized its business to become a single reportable segment: tobacco.

revenueModel.text: Other established tobacco brands pay for turnkey contract manufacturing of cigarettes and filtered cigars.
revenueModel.evidence: We also provide turnkey contract manufacturing of cigarettes and filtered cigars for other established tobacco brands.

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2023 the company became a single tobacco reportable segment after divesting its former hemp/cannabis business.
